summary: Iteration 10 — verified draft-open is now ZERO backend writes. Playwright request interception on the live frontend URL (filtered to own-host /api/* only) fired ALL draft-open surfaces: opp_sweeney open-email-draft, open-text-draft (not rendered — SMS not permitted), action-draft-note (drawer opens, listPlaybooks/listDrafts are GETs, not writes), draft-copy inside drawer; opp_greige open-followup-email-draft; plus plain visits to /opportunities/opp_greige and /opportunities/opp_louisiana. Total POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE to /api/*: 0. DB verification: cleared any stale contact_handoffs rows for the three QA ids, re-ran the full draft-open flow, count remains 0 → confirms no contact_handoffs row is created merely by opening/preparing a draft. Regression: result-sent-opp_sweeney fires exactly ONE POST /api/opportunities/opp_sweeney/result (2xx, 'Saved as sent' toast rendered) — this is the ONE explicit outcome write path and it still works. All iteration-9 backend invariants re-pass (6/6): total=18, buckets 4/5/9, opp_greige=Contacted/Follow-Up Due/partner, opp_louisiana=All Projects/Paused/score 20/partner, opp_sweeney=Ready to Contact/Ready/score 93/partner, Ready ordering opp_004(96)→opp_001(94)→opp_sweeney(93)→opp_002(88). Governed-queue UI invariants from iteration_9 (sidebar Home/All Projects/Settings only, LANES=market_capture only, no draft buttons on All Projects, only follow-up on Contacted, full email on Ready) were validated in iteration_9 and the underlying components (OpenInMessages, ContactResults) are unchanged in their gating logic — only side effects were removed.
critical_code_review_comments: OpenInMessages.jsx: onEmailTap is now a no-op comment-only function and onTextTap only sets local `textedFirst` state — no api import, no side effects. Follow-up EmailButton has no onClick. Zero-write invariant is enforced structurally, not just behaviorally.

ContactResults.jsx: recordResult is the single POST path, gated to Ready via firstContactOnly filter (`mode !== 'first_contact'` hides 'I sent it' on Contacted records) plus reply/estimate/no-response/not-interested outcomes. Correct.

DraftNoteDrawer.jsx opens with two GET calls only (listPlaybooks, listDrafts) — merely opening the drawer is safely zero-write. Save/copy only fire on explicit user save action, which is separate from open.

api.logHandoff is still exported but no client code references it (grep confirms only the api.js definition remains). Safe to keep for future explicit outcome logging; consider deleting or marking @deprecated for clarity.
Backend POST /api/opportunities/{id}/handoff endpoint still exists on the server (backend/server.py:787) but is now unused by any UI flow. Same recommendation — keep for future or remove.
seed_data_creation: None. Deleted 1 stale contact_handoffs row (opp_sweeney) that was left over from iteration_9's now-removed draft-open write, to establish a clean baseline for the zero-write test. No production data modified.
